Eine schnell aufgetragene Salbe. Heilt 1: A quickly applied salve. Heals 14 health.

Schlussfolgerungen bringen 1 Ansehen meh: Conclusions bring 1 more reputation. From Wexmoor on also +30 shillings per conclusion.
Schlussfolgerungen im Notizbuch ziehen u: Draw conclusions in the notebook and confirm information with two sources.
Schlösser erzählen dir, wie sie aufgehen: Locks tell you how they want to open. Locked files open to you sooner.
Schlösser öffnen sich früher (Ansehen -2: Locks open earlier (reputation -20). The manhunt fades 50 % faster.
Schlösser öffnen sich leichter. Die Fahn: Locks open more easily. The manhunt fades 50 % faster.
Locks open more easily. The manhunt fades 62 % faster.
Schlösser öffnen sich noch früher (Anseh: Locks open even earlier (reputation -10). The manhunt fades 25 % faster.
Locks open even earlier (reputation -15). The manhunt fades 38 % faster.
Seide, die man nur sieht, wenn man nicht: Silk you only see when you're not looking.
Silver from melted-down lockpicks. Fits any lock.
Spann drei Fäden Spinnenseide zwischen d: Stretch three threads of spider silk between your fingers and take the thread test: four traces the fog throws at you, and each must be tied to the conclusion that bears it. Strange cases, strange traces. Where the net holds, you may drink.
Spiele jede Rolle, aber verliere dich ni: Play every role, but don't lose yourself.
Staub von Flügeln, die nie ein Lampenlic: Dust from wings that never touched lamplight.
Steig in die alten Gaskanäle, entzünde z: Climb into the old gas tunnels, light two lamps against the darkness and keep Spirit Sight open until the fog retreats before you. Then drink.
Streu Glockenstaub und Grabmoos im Kreis: Scatter bell dust and grave moss in a circle around you, wherever you stand, and listen: three voices speak from the fog. One comes back as an echo. Name it. They're different every time. Then drink.
Tränke und Mittel am Braukessel herstell: Make potions and remedies at the brewing cauldron, use remedies and tinctures.
Potions digest only half as fast.
Türen seufzen erleichtert, wenn du komms: Doors sigh with relief when you come. So do purses.
Unrest fades only half as fast.
Unruhe steigt langsam, solange du ihn tr: Unrest rises slowly while you carry it.
Unrest rises while you carry it.
Unsichtbare Fäden fesseln den Gegner. Er: Invisible threads bind the enemy. They skip a turn and are vulnerable (weak spot).
Unter Kettlegate liegen mehr Tote als da: Beneath Kettlegate lie more dead than there are living above. The gravediggers of St. Ebba knew a brew that opens the ears to their whispers. Whoever listens too long eventually answers.
Unter deiner Maske liegt eine zweite. Ma: Beneath your mask lies a second one. Sometimes even you don't know which one is speaking.
Verborgene Spuren in der Geistsicht find: Find hidden traces with Spirit Sight, refute lies, defeat occult beings.
Viele Gespräche führen, handeln und feil: Hold many conversations, trade and haggle, do side jobs for the people of the city.
Vier Schläge entlang der Bruchstellen. K: Four blows along the fault lines. No beat is lost, and the enemy becomes vulnerable.
From spiders that weave only in clock towers.
From an owl that never blinks.
Von einer Kanalkröte. Giftig, wenn man i: From a canal toad. Poisonous if dosed wrong.
Von einer Krähe, die einen Ring gestohle: From a crow that stole a ring.
Wachs, in dem man sich spiegelt. Allerdi: Wax you can see yourself in. With a stranger's face, though.
Was heilt, kann auch töten. Deine Tinktu: What heals can also kill. Your tinctures also calm inner unrest.
Wenn du sprichst, antworten Stimmen aus: When you speak, voices answer from walls and graves. Not all of them are friendly.
Wächst nur auf Gräbern, die niemand mehr: Grows only on graves nobody visits any more.
Grows only where light never falls.
Zehn Laternen in einem Monstergebiet, je: Ten lanterns in a monster area, one lamp oil each, and between them the light condenses into a body that has your stance. The beast is as strong as you. Only a glow may finish it. Afterwards you lay two shards of star glass in the cold circle of lanterns.
Zehn lila Spinnfäden, um Arme, Brust und: Ten purple spider threads wound around arms, chest and legs until every step grows heavy. Only when health and nerves are almost spent do you lure the spider out of the yarn and defeat it while wrapped. Then you knot two owl feathers into the torn web.
Zu Beginn jeder weiteren Runde +1 Konzen: +1 focus at the start of every further round.
Zu Beginn jeder weiteren Runde +2 Konzen: +2 focus at the start of every further round.
Zwei Schläge aus zwei Richtungen, dann b: Two blows from two directions, then you're elsewhere. The next attack misses.
Zwei Schläge entlang der Fäden. Selbst e: Two blows along the threads. Even a missed beat still hits normally, and no armour stops the threads.
Zwei Schläge wie Hammerschläge. Je 220 %: Two blows like hammer strikes. 220 % weapon damage each, the enemy staggers and skips a turn.
Zwei Schnitte aus Licht. Je 13 Schaden,: Two cuts of light. 13 damage each, double against the occult, and the weak spot lies open.
Zwei Stiche aus dem Schatten, dann bist: Two stabs from the shadows, then you're gone. The next attack misses.
Zwei Würfe mit wandelnden Tinkturen. Je: Two throws of shifting tinctures. 12 damage each, 8 damage for 3 rounds, and the armour crumbles.
Zwei flinke Stiche und ein Griff in die: Two nimble stabs and a grab into the wrong pocket. Next time the enemy strikes themselves.
Two wedding rings fused together. Whoever wears it heals for two.
Zwölf Fingerknöchel auf einer Schnur. We: Twelve knuckle bones on a string. Whoever lets them slide through their hand while striking stays focused. The rosary doesn't count defence.
Zähe Stängel, die zwischen Hafenpflaster: Tough stalks that grow between harbour cobbles.
Zähne aus dem Moor, auf Draht gezogen. S: Teeth from the moor, strung on wire. They rattle when you're angry.
Öl, das im Wasser brennt. Teuer, gefährl: Oil that burns in water. Expensive, dangerous, wonderful.
